test_title: PYST 80: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter- cluster that is different.

Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**1) ORTU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdd8292559c94f1ec07ff782984280e7c634a085d81094a3bea6f9701722b5d4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4b840fe069b99dcac31d871473530414988adff47c43e52d220b594ffcfcc71.png] 

2) XZCH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f98e05a3df09f343241d1c40ffa63fcb848d8a621c9f2c19ca7fc686e7b7ac99.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db20c0d68e843d818d893d7de7f79221dc4b26f09a90fe986eeb1efa6e0d65ff.png] 

3) MORW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/780e8a36ab984df415fded10e8f8056ab9fdc44168fe35e08db64cf2b2679dcc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad856b7eac1a888c87b17bddb8ae6c195d083a12b2e3dce3904cae02a1bffb65.png] 

4) PRUZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f0106a5ee5dc0472b00c31ef6bd98b8f389559fe7b36754ada17eaa32275bb6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00bc55051d6f6be3cbc6ce49c389fe4c3565aabdb3de6f7cdd4bf822f7c0261b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ORTU".**
